notes: Time Charter Hire invoices: a new invoice type for ship owners and operators. Hire lines with Period From and To, Days worked out from the dates (editable, decimals allowed) and a Rate Per Day; VAT per line (Standard 5%, Zero-rated or Exempt); no quantity or discount. Totals: Sub Total, VAT, Total, Less Advance Payment Hire, Balance Due, taking the customer's advance receipts. Print and PDF in the same layout. Also: a wider description column on service invoices, and a purchase line's VAT is now chosen from a list.
